## v0.4.1

- Reduce local document storage with one gzip-compressed previous revision per document.
- Rotate backend logs at 256 KiB and keep one previous log.
- Resize imported resume photos to at most 640 pixels on the longest edge and store them as JPEG.
- Add local storage usage breakdown and a WebView2 disk-cache cleanup action in Settings.
- Cache cleanup preserves resumes, compressed backups, job favorites, application records, and site data.
